name: War-Awoken Overstratos (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒ストラトスオーバー
effects:
One single piercing jump attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if at least 0/2 allies have En-Wind
WS Blue: [Dualcast Wind 3, Instant Wind 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user]
WS Gold: [Surging Power +30% for 6 turns to party]
